Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns regarding your recent workplace behavior. We have received multiple complaints indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s values.

It is important that we maintain a professional and respectful environment for all team members. We expect an immediate improvement in your behavior and full adherence to our professional standards moving forward.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if there are any underlying issues we can help resolve.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***

The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.
